name: Depth Sorter
description: Orders everything in an isometric scene back to front so a painter can draw it without a depth buffer. Sorting by tile x+y is the usual answer, and it is correct only while every object sits on exactly one tile at one elevation. A building three tiles deep, or anything standing on a cliff, breaks it. This contract declares the ordering as a relation between pairs of volumes rather than as a sort key, because a relation is what it actually is: separated on an axis, the object further along that axis is in front, and the draw order is a topological sort of those pairs.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application (generator/iso/DepthSort.ts); not verifiable from this repository.
A depth buffer solves this in 3D.

inputs.name: maxSortedObjects
inputs.description: The pairwise ordering is quadratic in the number of objects whose screen boxes could overlap. Above this count the scene is banded and sorted band by band rather than whole.
